ModMetaData.name: Underlayer
ModMetaData.author: Unon
ModMetaData.description:
A little framework for mods that draw Dear ImGui windows on RimWorld 1.7.
Normally an ImGui window sits on top of everything, so it can hide a letter or a "Really quit?" box that pops up after it. Underlayer fixes that: ImGui windows from mods that use it stack with the game's own windows, in the same order the game uses.
It doesn't do anything by itself, you only need it when a mod asks for it. RimWorld 1.7 only.
